history.description: The village of Sailor Springs was officially incorporated on August 10, 1883, following the establishment of its post office.
The town became historically renowned as a popular health resort. Visitors traveled from hundreds of miles away to experience the curative mineral waters.
history.image_caption: Historic promotional materials for the mineral springs.

history.description: Following a local vote to ban alcohol, the health resort industry declined rapidly, as many patrons were discouraged by the change in local lifestyle.
As of the 2020 Census, Sailor Springs remains a quiet village in Clay County with a population of 89 residents.
